protocol.json.purpose: Diagnosis only: separate ROT and ROT+SWAP on the rejected unchanged ROT candidate and adopted baseline. No adoption decision or retroactive threshold changes.
protocol.json.platform: Windows CPU0, process CPU READY/DONE; no other timing, builds or tests overlap.
protocol.json.scale: For each case baseline-only pilot100M chooses N=ceil(100M*6sec/pilot CPU), then freeze before any candidate measurement. Pilot>=1 CPU tick required.
protocol.json.aa: At frozen N, one excluded warmup then5 samples per A1/A2, alternating order, independent2 series, require every median>=5 seconds and maxdelta<=2percent. Stop without candidate if unresolved; no automatic retries or choosing convenient results.
protocol.json.ab: At accepted N, one excluded warmup then7 samples per baseline/candidate, alternating order independent2 series. Mathematical weighted-order checksum, source/executable hashes each process series. Preserve all samples and outliers. Delta not a CI. No assertion of hardware cause from timing or static instructions alone.

scripts.run.py:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,sys,math,datetime,hashlib
out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;rows={};commands=[]
def save(name,obj):(out/name).write_text(json.dumps(obj,indent=2)+'\n')
def expected(case,n):
 seq=[1,2,3]
 if case=='rot':k=n%3;seq=seq[k:]+seq[:k]
 elif n%2:seq=[2,1,3]
 return 100*seq[0]+10*seq[1]+seq[2]
def run(stage,case,index=1):
 cmd=[sys.executable,str(out/'worker.py'),stage,case,'--series',str(index)];commands.append(cmd);save('commands.json',commands)
 with (out/(case+f'-{stage}-{index}.log')).open('wb') as f:r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 assert r.returncode==0,(stage,case,index,r.returncode)
 return json.loads((out/(case+f'-{stage}-{index}.json')).read_text())
cases={k:': BENCH-RUN 1 2 3 BENCH-ITERATIONS 0 DO '+word+' LOOP >R SWAP 100 * SWAP 10 * + R> + ;' for k,word in [('rot','ROT'),('rot-swap','ROT SWAP')]}
save('start.json',{'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'protocol.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
for case,definition in cases.items():
 c={'name':case,'iterations':100000000,'definition':definition,'checksum_expected':expected(case,100000000)};save(case+'-config.json',c);pilot=run('pilot',case);cpu=pilot['engines']['baseline']['median_us'];assert cpu>0
 n=math.ceil(100000000*6000000/cpu);assert n<2**63;c['iterations']=n;c['checksum_expected']=expected(case,n);c['baseline_pilot_cpu_us']=cpu;save(case+'-config.json',c)
 aa=[run('aa',case,i) for i in (1,2)];delta=max(x['aa_delta_percent'] for x in aa);minimum=min(v['median_us'] for x in aa for v in x['engines'].values());print('AA',case,n,'delta',delta,'min',minimum,flush=True)
 rows[case]={'config':c,'aa_delta_percent':delta,'minimum_baseline_median_us':minimum};save('results.json',rows)
 if minimum<5000000 or delta>2:save('stop.json',{'reason':'unresolved diagnostic calibration; no candidate timing for this case','case':case});raise SystemExit(0)
 ab=[run('compare',case,i) for i in (1,2)];rows[case]['changes_percent']=[x['change_percent'] for x in ab];save('results.json',rows);print('AB',case,rows[case]['changes_percent'],flush=True)
save('complete.json',{'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'diagnostic_cases':len(rows),'purpose':'diagnosis only; no cause or adoption claim'})
